scripts.postinstall: node -e "try { require('child_process').execSync('chmod +x node_modules/.bin/* node_modules/.pnpm/*/node_modules/.bin/* node_modules/@esbuild/*/bin/* 2>/dev/null'); } catch (e) {}"
scripts.build: cd apps/web && npx vite build && node -e "try { require('fs').cpSync('../../dist/apps/web', '../../dist', { recursive: true }); } catch (e) {}"
